tests.name: World is 2.59 times larger with nine distinct regions and a continuous road loop
Original seed layout, enemy IDs and story locations remain unchanged
All shrines, all chests and all four beacons are reachable on foot across multiple seeds
River banks block walking while both wooden bridges are traversable
A new beacon requires two full waves before granting its reward exactly once
Travel rejects locked destinations and remote calls, cancels a dodge and allows safe return from its menu
A v0.2 save retains hero, health, gold, armor, weapons, relics and awakened seals
Saving mid encounter preserves the active wave, unique guardian IDs and destination unlocks
New region coordinates survive save restoration and do not fall back to the village
Nearby loot cannot trap the interaction at the center of an unlocked station
Death resets unfinished outpost waves while keeping earned unlocks
All heroes emit their own skill visuals and retain resource and cooldown rules
Running animation follows real movement and a wall does not advance the stride
Reduced motion disables new dash afterimages without disabling the actual dodge
The original finale remains gated; postgame frontier enemies can still deal damage
New game code parses and generated atlas stays within hosting limits
